examples.title: One task across four live adapters
examples.title_zh: 四个真实适配器的同一任务
examples.execution_boundary: user-authorized provider calls
prerequisites: A user-owned exact execution profile and the selected host. Export and verify are offline.
prerequisites_zh: 用户自有、明确授权的 execution profile，以及所选宿主。导出与验证均离线。

examples.title: Editable native plugin and resource
examples.title_zh: 可修改的原生插件与资源
examples.execution_boundary: no model; runtime requires supported local process/IPC permissions
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness in the same environment.
Install the exported plugin with the explicit command below; exporting never installs or executes it.
Linux/POSIX runtime with the process and Unix-domain socket permissions required by the harness.
The declaration selfcheck checks a wheel installation: explicitly build/install your plugin wheel first; editable imports are diagnosed. It executes trusted selected factory code.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.11+，且同一环境已安装 rpnh-harness。
按下方命令明确安装导出的插件；导出操作不会安装或执行代码。
运行需 Linux/POSIX 与 harness 所需的进程及 Unix-domain socket 权限。
声明自检核对 wheel 安装：请先明确构建并安装插件 wheel；editable 导入会被诊断。此检查执行所选可信 factory 代码。
commands: rpnh plugins --config examples/native_plugin/plugins.json run demo/add --input examples/native_plugin/input.json --run-dir /absolute/absent/add-run

examples.title: Editable model/program/model workflow
examples.title_zh: 可修改的模型/程序/模型工作流
examples.execution_boundary: scripted local fixture by default; real provider only with explicit --execution
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness in the same environment.
Install the included native_plugin; keep examples/_support and native_plugin beside hybrid_summary.
Scripted runs still need supported local process/IPC permissions. A live profile is optional and separately authorized.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.11+，且同一环境已安装 rpnh-harness。
安装随附 native_plugin；保留 hybrid_summary 同级的 examples/_support 和 native_plugin。
脚本化运行仍需本地进程/IPC 权限；真实 profile 为额外授权的可选项。

examples.title: Two-stage definition composition only
examples.title_zh: 仅定义层的两阶段组合
examples.execution_boundary: definition only; no Registry run, executor registration or model call
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness.
This prints a ModuleDeclaration. Running it as a task additionally requires matching trusted executor, component, terminal and schema registrations; none are installed by this export.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.11+，且已安装 rpnh-harness。
本例只输出 ModuleDeclaration；执行为任务还需匹配的受信 executor/component/terminal/schema 注册，本次导出不会安装这些注册。

examples.title: Reusable v2 package and trusted native profile
examples.title_zh: 可复用 v2 包与受信原生 profile
examples.execution_boundary: data-only package authoring and resolution; execution is a separate explicit step
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ and installed rpnh-harness.
Follow the included guide to build/install the trusted native plugin and prepare a v2 package.
Preview and resolve do not execute package code. Runtime needs supported process/IPC permissions.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.11+，且已安装 rpnh-harness。
按随附指南构建/安装受信原生插件并准备 v2 包。
preview 与 resolve 不执行包代码；运行仍需支持的进程/IPC 权限。

examples.title: Serial, parallel, document and long-process gallery
examples.execution_boundary: scripted by default; optional live profile
prerequisites: Source checkout plus examples/_support; read its guide before choosing a scenario.

examples.title: Independent task workspaces
examples.execution_boundary: scripted local process
prerequisites: Source checkout plus examples/_support and supported local process/IPC permissions.

examples.title: Live net replacement
examples.execution_boundary: explicit live provider calls
prerequisites: Source checkout and separately authorized exact execution profile. compose_serial is the separately exportable definition-only subset.

examples.title: Clinical document/data research packet
examples.execution_boundary: explicit live provider calls
prerequisites: Linux/WSL2, source checkout, installed RPNH and a separately authorized exact execution profile.
Obtain the official article/supplements listed in sources.json; those files and participant rows are not redistributed here.
Preparation embeds participant-level workbook text in the prompt. Review source/privacy terms and explicitly acknowledge that data transfer before any provider-backed run.

examples.title: Numerical optimal-control research example
examples.execution_boundary: explicit live provider calls
prerequisites: Linux/WSL2, source checkout, installed RPNH and a separately authorized exact execution profile.
The selected workspace must provide numerical packages used by the task (NumPy/SciPy is the documented common path); read sources.json and the source guide.

examples.title: HarnessAudit Office benchmark
examples.execution_boundary: retained results offline; new runs require authorized profiles
prerequisites: Linux/WSL2, Python 3.11+, source checkout and separately installed examples/harnessaudit_office dependencies (PyYAML, jsonschema).
Separately install UCSB-AI/HarnessAudit pinned at 6317162590aeeb1c8dde32b880ac199933343e4a with its oai extra; read source-pins.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
Retained results need no provider. New runs/scoring require the setup in the source guide and explicitly authorized local profiles.

examples.title: RRSI v0.6 application
examples.execution_boundary: explicit live provider calls
prerequisites: Python 3.11+, source checkout and separately installed examples/rrsi_v06 package/test dependencies.
Read THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and the protocol; new provider-backed rounds and independent child runs require a user-owned, explicitly authorized exact execution profile.

examples.title: AutomationBench benchmark and extensions
examples.execution_boundary: retained results offline; new live runs need authorization
prerequisites: Python 3.13+ in an independent environment (core RPNH only requires Python 3.11+).
A source checkout plus separately installed zapier/AutomationBench pinned at 4a8e1061254004d9dac807054eed33fad7d1ff14 (1.0.6); follow its README/RUNBOOK and license terms.
A user-owned, separately authorized exact execution profile for new live runs. Retained results are readable offline; benchmark execution dependencies are not exported.

examples.title: Multi-user release handoff
examples.execution_boundary: offline preflight; new model runs require explicit authorization
prerequisites: Source checkout, installed RPNH and the original task/dependencies described in RUNNING.md.
Four independent user Tasks and a separate Source Registry; retained recovery evidence is not a portable one-command resume. New model runs need an explicitly authorized exact execution profile.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、已安装 RPNH，以及 RUNNING_ZH.md 指定的原任务和依赖。
四个独立用户 Task 与单独 Source Registry；保留的恢复证据不是便携的一键恢复入口。新模型运行需明确授权的精确 execution profile。

examples.title: Copy, merge and reuse an agent project
examples.title_zh: 复制、合并并复用 Agent 项目
examples.execution_boundary: new agent runs require explicitly authorized profiles
prerequisites: Source checkout plus the example package and its documented pandas/pyarrow dependencies.
Read the source guide for original task inputs, controlled contributors, exact version adoption and separate receiver execution; authorize model and budget before new runs.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout，以及案例包和指南指定的 pandas/pyarrow 依赖。
按源码指南准备原任务输入、受控贡献者、精确版本采用和独立接收端运行；新运行前明确授权模型与预算。

examples.title: Two contributors build an agent task net
examples.title_zh: 两位贡献者共建 Agent 任务网
examples.execution_boundary: deterministic local-process agent protocol; no external model/provider
prerequisites: Source checkout and a compatible installed RPNH with supported process/Unix-domain socket permissions.
Uses the included scripted model protocol and fresh short work directories; it does not demonstrate live-model reasoning or independent remote identities.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、兼容的 RPNH 安装，以及所需进程和 Unix-domain socket 权限。
使用随附脚本模型协议和新的短工作路径；不代表真实模型推理或独立远程身份。

examples.title: ERP-Bench managed agent tasks
examples.title_zh: ERP-Bench 受管 Agent 任务
examples.execution_boundary: offline result inspection; new live trials require explicit authorization
prerequisites: Python 3.12+, source checkout and the separately installed example package with its pinned Harbor dependency.
Live trials need the original Docker environment/verifier, supported Linux/WSL process/IPC and explicitly authorized exact model/profile and task budget.
prerequisites_zh: Python 3.12+、源码 checkout，以及独立安装的案例包和固定 Harbor 依赖。
实时试验需原 Docker 环境/验证器、支持进程/IPC 的 Linux/WSL，以及明确授权的精确模型/profile和任务预算。

examples.title: SlopCodeBench native Session pilot
examples.title_zh: SlopCodeBench 原生 Session 试验
examples.execution_boundary: scripted lifecycle fixtures or separately authorized live profile
prerequisites: Source checkout, the separate example package and the fixed upstream Docker Session/Snapshot environment described in its guide.
Retained prefix results are not the complete benchmark; new provider-backed runs require explicit model and budget authorization.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、独立案例包，以及指南指定的固定上游 Docker Session/Snapshot 环境。
保留的前缀结果不是完整 benchmark；新的 provider 运行需明确授权模型与预算。

examples.title: Registered deterministic tool pipeline
examples.title_zh: 登记的确定性工具流水线
examples.execution_boundary: deterministic HOST tools; no model calls
prerequisites: Source checkout and a compatible installed RPNH with supported local process/IPC permissions.
Read the guide for the typed tool contracts and synthetic billing input; tool operations are not agent identities.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、兼容的 RPNH 安装及支持的本地进程/IPC 权限。
按指南理解类型化工具合同和合成电费输入；工具操作不是 Agent 身份。

examples.title: Read-only SQL execution and exact comparison
examples.title_zh: 只读 SQL 执行与精确比较
examples.execution_boundary: fixed SQL candidates; no model/provider calls
prerequisites: Source checkout, installed RPNH and the original task database/SQL inputs identified in sources.json.
Read the preparation and verifier boundaries in the guide; commands do not download task data, install dependencies or run the official grader implicitly.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、已安装 RPNH，以及 sources.json 指定的原任务数据库和 SQL 输入。
按指南区分准备与验证边界；命令不会隐式下载任务数据、安装依赖或运行官方 grader。

examples.title: Merge original JSON, CSV and Parquet inputs
examples.title_zh: 合并原始 JSON CSV 与 Parquet 输入
examples.execution_boundary: deterministic HOST tools; no model calls
prerequisites: Source checkout, compatible RPNH, pandas, pyarrow and pytest; use the included original task inputs described in the guide.
Runtime needs supported process/Unix-domain socket permissions. Path-adapted verification is distinct from executing the original task container.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、兼容 RPNH、pandas、pyarrow 和 pytest；使用指南说明的随附原任务输入。
运行需支持进程/Unix-domain socket 权限；路径适配验证与执行原任务容器分开。

examples.title: Bounded synthetic iteration
examples.execution_boundary: deterministic HOST fixture; no model-improvement claim
prerequisites: Source checkout and compatible RPNH; follow the guide for bounded one-to-four-round scenarios.
The synthetic integer-distance task demonstrates iteration contracts, not general recursive model improvement.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout 和兼容 RPNH；按指南选择一至四轮的有界场景。
合成整数距离任务展示迭代合同，不证明通用递归模型改进。

examples.title: Shared example evidence validation
examples.execution_boundary: read-only evidence validation; no task or model execution
prerequisites: Source checkout and the validator dependencies documented in the guide.
Validates evidence and result manifests; it has no independent PN and does not rerun a business task or certify an untested runtime.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout 和指南指定的验证器依赖。
校验证据与结果清单；无独立 PN，不重跑业务任务，也不认证未经测试的运行时。

examples.title: Controlled refund approval fixture
examples.execution_boundary: local simulated approval; no money or model calls
prerequisites: Source checkout, compatible RPNH and the local application dependencies described in the guide.
Uses controlled local requester/approver identities and synthetic refund data; not a payment integration.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、兼容 RPNH 及指南说明的本地应用依赖。
使用受控本地申请者/审批者身份和合成退款数据；不是支付接入。

examples.title: Controlled quote-input fixture
examples.execution_boundary: local HTTP status fixture; no external service or model calls
prerequisites: Source checkout, compatible RPNH and the local application setup described in the guide.
The bounded synthetic protocol fixture does not establish interoperability with external A2A agents or real quote/booking services.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、兼容 RPNH 及指南指定的本地应用设置。
有界合成协议夹具不证明外部 A2A Agent 互操作或真实报价/预订服务接入。

examples.title: Historical route contribution evidence
examples.execution_boundary: historical mechanism/results; see the source guide before execution
prerequisites: Source checkout to inspect the retained route versions, results and failures.
Current agent-contract collaboration is the separate agent_cobuild example. Historical route tool operations must not be counted as agents or new validation.
prerequisites_zh: 从源码 checkout 查阅保留的路线版本、结果与失败。
当前 Agent 合同协作见独立 agent_cobuild 案例；历史路线工具操作不计为 Agent 或新的验证。

examples.title: Historical native billing contributions
examples.execution_boundary: deterministic sources and tools; no model/provider or payment calls
prerequisites: Source checkout and a compatible installed RPNH with supported local process/IPC permissions.
Controlled source principals modify a historical ten-tool billing net; this is not an agent task net or production billing service.
prerequisites_zh: 源码 checkout、兼容的 RPNH 安装及支持的本地进程/IPC 权限。
受控 source 主体修改历史十工具电费网；这不是 Agent 任务网或生产计费服务。
